{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too low during price declines, showing excessive mean reversion to recent lows",
    "When sentiment is positive (>=0.67), model forecasts undershoot true prices by 1-2 euros",
    "When sentiment is negative (<=0.33), model over-forecasts declines compared to actual resilience at support levels",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to neutral (0 → 0.33-0.67) requires lifting forecasts 0.5-1.0 euros above model baseline",
    "Prolonged flat sentiment (all 0.33-0.67 in last 18 days) calls for maintaining model values as they're already aligned",
    "When price has been volatile with no clear trend, model's initial value is usually correct and corrections should follow true price trajectory rather than extrapolating model's drift"
] }
